text: This report responds to City Council's request to the City Manager at its meeting of February 12, 2018, to submit a report on the Multi-Year Service Plans and Strategies to the same meeting that is considering the Long-Term Financial Direction and Financing Strategies for Smart Track and Imagination, Manufacturing, Innovation and Technology Property Tax Incentive Program (IMIT), for consideration in the 2019 Budget process. This report identifies multi-year service plans and strategies approved by City Council for which Programs and Agencies have identified and submitted financial estimates such as the Toronto Poverty Reduction Strategy, Toronto Transit Commission Ridership Growth Strategy, Child Care Growth Strategy, and TransformTO.
